<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .
@prefix ex: <http://example.org/ex#> .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape for each ship: must reference a hull‑boundary point that
# defines the bottom/lower‑region boundary.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
ex:ShipShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:hasBottomRegionLowerRegionBoundaryPoint ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:node ex:HullBoundaryPointShape ;
    ] .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape for the hull‑boundary point that is linked from a ship.
# It must carry a shell‑inclination‑angle quantity.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
ex:HullBoundaryPointShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:hullBoundaryPoint ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:shellInclinationAngle ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:node ex:ShellInclinationAngleValueShape ;
    ] .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape for the QuantityValue representing the shell inclination.
# The value must be exactly 7 degrees.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
ex:ShellInclinationAngleValueShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass qudt:QuantityValue ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:hasValue "7"^^xsd:decimal ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:hasValue unit:DEG ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
